subject: (a) Yes: seg22 may apply the lazy-route edits in other owners' route files. (b) S14 splits AssistantSurface below 150 KB; no exemption
body: (a) Keep the edits route-module only (lazyPage wrappers and dynamic imports): no behaviour changes, one commit per owner area with the owner tagged, and post a claim note first. If a file is mid-rework by its owner (S16 planner, S17 pathway), coordinate through the ledger and let the owner apply it after their re-review instead. (b) seg14: split the assistant surface. Lazy-load the markdown/KaTeX renderer, the canvas kinds and the LangGraph SDK; the composer shell stays small. On-demand surfaces still get a 150 KB per-chunk budget, because the assistant opens on iPad over weak networks. Note it in S14's done message.
